audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of Jodi’s dinner invitation, Pierre’s first-year seed announcement, and Shane’s apology and therapy decision. Every spoken line, invitation detail, fish and casserole reference, sales pitch, response option, mental-health statement, and emotional beat was reviewed in full event context with consistent Ukrainian terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, quest state, response IDs and friendship deltas, gender and dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The remaining Farm records and full-locale final audits remain pending.
